create_gold_config: create a GOLDConfig instance to configure student-teacher distillation training with Jensen-Shannon divergence loss
configure_gold_teacher_model: configure a GOLDConfig with a teacher model name, revision, and tokenizer for knowledge distillation
enable_uld_distillation_loss: enable ULD loss in GOLDConfig with student and teacher temperatures and cross-entropy weights
configure_vllm_generation: configure GOLDConfig to use vLLM for fast student completions with colocated or server mode
validate_gold_config_params: validate GOLDConfig parameters including lmbda, beta, batch sizes, and ULD weight constraints
